decision_conditions:
The window(s) in the flank elevation(s) of the proposed development shall:
(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;Fire Safety Statement, ST_MAR26_23 
ELM_001 REV C, ST_APR26_23 ELM_002 REV A, ST_MAR26_23 
ELM_003 REV C, ST_MAR26_23 ELM_000

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
description: Conversion of garage into habitable room with alterations to front elevation; alterations to single storey roofs at side and rear; rooflights in side and rear roof slopes; removal of chimney breast; external alterations
